description: This file defines a template class 'FixedArray' in the Abseil C++ library, providing a fixed-size, non-resizable array with inline storage optimization, including constructors, accessors, iterators, and comparison operators.

classes.name: FixedArray
classes.description: A template class implementing a fixed-size, non-resizable array with inline storage optimization, supporting various constructors, element access, iteration, comparison, and hash functions.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the FixedArray.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements the FixedArray can hold.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the FixedArray is empty.

methods.name: memsize
methods.description: Returns the total memory size in bytes occupied by the FixedArray.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying array elements.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Provides element access with bounds assertion.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Provides bounds-checked element access, throws std::out_of_range if out of bounds.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns a reference to the first element.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns a reference to the last element.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator past the last element.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to before the first element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills all elements with a specified value.
